not_observable.why_not_observable: The setup detail string is not a finding and not part of the frozen contract (the gate contract fixes exit 2 for setup, not the detail text); the panel compares findings, notes, the result line and the exit code, all unchanged.
The registry panel never passes --selftest; the mutant is observable only through the counter's selftest leg, which is outside this panel.
The constant is read only by gate_selftest; no registry run prints it, so the panel cannot see the trailing space.
JSON object key order is not semantic; the harness parses the object, so a reordered object is the same answer.
Dropping the guard makes os.listdir raise FileNotFoundError on a missing entry dir: the gate crashes instead of printing a finding, and a crash is not a kill under this panel's detector.
PROG appears only in the usage line written when --repo is absent; no panel input invokes the gate without --repo.
